provenance.construction: Two disjoint X-side four-check row-space grafts of codes/798-8-27.json by @dorakingx. First XOR source rows [360,376,377,378] to form S1=[360,361,378,762,781,782], pivot row 376, remove qubit 378. Then XOR source rows [0,1,18,19] to form S2=[1,3,21,22,399,400,418,420], pivot row 0, remove source qubit 399 (index 398 after the first reduction). For each graft replace the pivot by S, clear its target qubit from other X rows using S, apply CNOT fanout from the target to S\{target}, and delete the disentangled qubit. Retain source coordinates of surviving qubits.
